must_detect_contradictions.source_a: prd_draft.md says rank candidates from best to worst match
must_detect_contradictions.source_b: transcript.txt and constraints.md warn against automated ranking or decisioning

must_detect_contradictions.source_a: prd_draft.md says export a shortlist of top candidates
must_detect_contradictions.source_b: transcript.txt says a human can create a shortlist and the system should not auto-shortlist without review

must_detect_contradictions.source_a: prd_draft.md says store profiles for future job openings
must_detect_contradictions.source_b: transcript.txt and constraints.md say retention requires consent and may be avoided in MVP

must_ask_questions: Should the MVP avoid candidate ranking and instead show requirement-by-requirement match evidence?
Should shortlist export be user-selected only rather than automatically generated?
What retention policy should apply to candidate CVs and extracted profiles?
Should the MVP process only one job opening at a time?
must_include_requirements: Recruiters can upload a job description.
The system extracts structured candidate profiles.
The system compares candidate evidence against job requirements.
Human recruiters remain in control of decisions.
must_not_include: The system makes final hiring recommendations.
ATS integration is required in MVP.
